transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been bringing you here today?

Well, what finally scared me into making this appointment is that I’ve been having some troubling thoughts lately. Just thinking things like... if I didn’t wake up tomorrow, that might be easier. I want to be clear that I don’t want to hurt myself. But just having those kinds of thoughts at all made me realize I needed to come in and talk to someone.
How long have you been experiencing these thoughts and feelings?

Well, it's been about two months. This whole... up-and-down stretch with my mood and my energy, it's been going on since the trouble with our new district manager really started at work. That was roughly two months ago, and I've just been dealing with it ever since.
Have you noticed yourself losing interest or not getting pleasure from things you usually enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with friends or family?

Yes, I have noticed that. I've always enjoyed art, but lately... well, I still set out my paints at home, or I'll think about going to my pottery class. But when I actually sit down with the materials, I just kind of stare at them. I don't feel any of the spark or enjoyment I used to feel from doing it. It just feels empty.
Have you found yourself feeling down, sad, or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, rather than just having ups and downs with your mood?

Yes, I would say it's most of the day. Most mornings lately, I just... I wake up with this heavy, gray feeling. It's like all the color has just drained out of everything before I even get dressed to head into the store. And that feeling pretty much stays with me until I go back to sleep.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, feeling restless or fidgety more than usual?

Yes, I've actually noticed a bit of both. Some days I'll catch myself just pacing around the living room and picking at my cuticles, feeling like I can't really settle down. But then other days... well, even just walking from the break room out to the sales floor feels strangely slow. It's like my body just doesn't want to move at its normal pace.
Have you ever had periods where you felt unusually upbeat, overly confident, or so energetic that you didn’t feel like you needed much sleep?

Yes, actually. Right before this whole slump started, I had a stretch of a few days where I felt... almost too sure of myself, I guess. I had a lot of energy. But I also found myself getting really irritable. Like, I would just snap at people over the tiniest things. Especially at work—if my district manager even questioned one of my store layouts, I would just bite their head off. It wasn't really like me.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least a few days where you felt extremely upbeat, unusually energetic, or so confident that it was out of character for you?

Well, like I was just saying, that stretch right before this current slump is probably exactly what you're talking about. I definitely felt unusually energetic and maybe a bit too confident for those few days. But if you mean other than that specific time... no, I don't really think so. I haven't noticed it happening besides that one recent period.

Before this most recent episode of feeling down and losing interest in things, have you ever had another period lasting two weeks or more where you felt persistently low or lost pleasure in your usual activities?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had bad days here and there, like anyone else, but nothing that lasted for two weeks straight before this current stretch. This is really the first time it's been this bad for this long.
Have you ever had any other episodes in your life where you felt extremely upbeat, unusually energetic, or overly confident, even if it was just for a couple of days?

No, like I mentioned, it really was just that one time right before this current low period. I can't think of any other time in my life where I felt like that, even just for a couple of days. It was just that one isolated stretch.
Before this current period of feeling down, have you ever had any shorter periods where you felt persistently low or lost pleasure in your usual activities, even if it was just for a few days?

No, not really. I mean, like I said, I've had normal bad days, but... nothing that really stands out as a stretch of days where I just couldn't enjoy anything. It's really just been this one time lately.
